selection.rule: harness.pairact_r1.select_checkpoint over OFFLINE_GATE.md G1-G5; heldout never used

trainer.init: fresh (pretrained ResNet18 backbone, same as beamact2/3); no beamact3 checkpoint init

notes: arm N (t5-architecture-advice.md): same collected dataset, same stage sidecar, same hyperparameters and seed as arm F (PAIRACT_R1_TRAIN_CONFIG_DRAFT.json). harness.pairact_r1.assert_arm_pair enforces the equality.

near_only_v1: rows whose h0 stage target is 'carry' (teacher carry:carry_hold .. carry:zone_settle = carry and door passage) get sampler weight 0; carry horizon entries of the remaining rows are masked like padding in the action, done and stage losses.

trained: approach, alignment, READY, grasp (execute), 3 s hold, recover, place (lower/open/raise/retreat), complete. At evaluation the carry segment is run by code (hybrid, HYBRID_RUN.md); arm N is never evaluated as a pure student.
label: '학습 근거리 + 코드 운반(hybrid)'. Never pooled with arm F ('학습 전 구간').
issued_clock_deadband applies at COLLECTION (recorder clocks) and EVALUATION; training reads recorded clocks only.
dropout_min_k=12 deviates from act18 A-r1 (k in 1..15) because beamact3 arm A zeroes history entries 0..10; see DESIGN.md D2.
place_sync stays off for r1 (second barrier is P2 pair_carry_sync scope) [확인 필요].
